nodes.label: Agent Mention (@lobe) Workflow
nodes.rationale: Remote code-agent entry (issue #9): only trusted humans (OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR, non-bot) mentioning @lobe trigger the Kimi Code CLI agent, to avoid drive-by API spend and self-triggering bot loops; handling is deliberately answer-only (agent never pushes code or opens PRs) and uses the Kimi Code Console endpoint (api.kimi.com/coding/v1) because Open Platform keys 401 there.
